findings.scientificReason: The whole carbohydrate cluster requires stereochemistry, anomers, assays and multiple carbohydrate classes beyond the supplied-glucose process lesson. Functional-group reading, amount of substance and the retained orientation are a defensible entry interface when glucose structure, molar masses and process data remain explicitly supplied. This is not proof that molar amount alone teaches every calculation.
findings.independentCaseChecks: D-glucose Fischer OH order R-L-R-R, six carbons, five OH and terminal aldehyde in open chain; aqueous ring forms predominate. Hydrolysis144g/0.8mol glucose gives73.6g theoretical and66.24g at90%;90g glucose gives46g theoretical and36.8g/46g=80%. Hydrolysis, respiration, fermentation and isolation losses remain distinct.
